# Inline demos that import packages

A `jsx` block: an external package plus a relative import that can't resolve
(an inline demo is a single file), and no type syntax.

```jsx live
import { DateTime } from "luxon";
import { helper } from "./helper";

export default function InlineDemo() {
  return <div>{DateTime.now().toISO()}{helper()}</div>;
}
```

A `tsx` block on the same page: a type-only import that must be skipped, a
value import that must not be, real JSX and a real type annotation.

```tsx live
import type { Settings } from "type-only-package";
import clsx from "clsx";

const label: string = "Inline";

export default function TypedInlineDemo({ settings }: { settings: Settings }) {
  return <div className={clsx("a", settings.theme)}>{label}</div>;
}
```
